What we collect. If you allow website tracking, Kentico Software s.r.o. assigns this browser an anonymous visitor record (a "contact") using the CurrentContact cookie. We record:

  • pages you visit and when;
  • the page you landed on and where you came from;
  • forms you submit.

If you're a member or subscriber, this activity is linked to your email address. Every Kentico Community email has a tracking image and tracked links, and we always record opens and clicks per email (see Email statistics). With website tracking on, your opens and clicks are also linked to this visitor record and recorded as activity.

Why. To understand which content is useful, improve Kentico Community, and show content that matches your interests, for example, content for people who visited certain sections.

What we don't do. We don't sell this data or share it with third parties for their own marketing or advertising, and we don't use it for advertising.

How long. Your activity is kept for up to 12 months. Anonymous visitor records are deleted after 12 months without activity. See Privacy.

Your choice. This is optional. Everything on Kentico Community, including membership, works without it. You can withdraw at any time in Cookie settings. Withdrawing stops tracking from that moment. Signing out also stops tracking in that browser.
ConsentLanguageVersion.ShortText: Track my activity on Kentico Community, such as pages I visit and forms I submit, and link my opens and clicks of Kentico Community emails to that activity, so Kentico can improve the site and personalize content for me. Details
